instruction: I've prepared some grammar tests in the 'Grammar test' folder. The Answer.docx file already contains the answers for Test 1. Could you please add the fill-in-the-blank answers for Grammar Test 2 Part 2 (questions 6-10) to the Answer document? Create a section labeled 'Test 2 Part 2: Fill in the Blanks' and list the 5 answers with their question numbers.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding 5 fill-in-the-blank answers from Test 2 Part 2 (Q6-10). Expected answers: Q6 (were), Q7 (had set), Q8 (was written/has been written), Q9 (will be completed), Q10 (don't need). Partial credit based on number of answers present.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit based on number of fill-blank answers (0.2 per answer, up to 1.0 for 5 answers)

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Evaluator only checks quantity (5 numbered items) but not quality (correct answers). Instruction requires specific answers (Q6=were, Q7=had set, Q8=was written/has been written, Q9=will be completed, Q10=don't need) but metric only counts items, not validates content.

CRITICAL: Section label requirement not verified. Instruction explicitly requires 'Create a section labeled Test 2 Part 2: Fill in the Blanks' but getter only checks for presence of 'Test 2' AND 'Part 2' in any paragraph, not the specific label format.
CRITICAL: Incomplete coverage - evaluator allows any text starting with numbers 6-10 to pass, even if answers are completely wrong. User could write '6. wrong', '7. wrong', etc. and get full credit.
Logic flaw in getter (lines 48-49): Checks if text starts with numbers 6-10 but doesn't validate if those are actual fill-in-the-blank answers or just any numbered text.
Expected values in metadata mention specific correct answers but these are never used in verification logic - the metric function ignores answer content entirely.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to extract actual answer text (not just numbered lines) and return list of answer strings for Q6-10.
Update expected section to include correct answers: {'6': 'were', '7': 'had set', '8': ['was written', 'has been written'], '9': 'will be completed', '10': "don't need"}.

Modify metric to verify: (1) section label 'Test 2 Part 2: Fill in the Blanks' exists, (2) all 5 question numbers present, (3) answer content matches expected (with fuzzy matching for acceptable variations).
Add logic to parse answer format like '6. were' or 'Q6: were' and extract the actual answer text for comparison.
Consider partial credit: 0.2 for section label present + 0.16 per correct answer (5 answers × 0.16 = 0.8) = 1.0 total.
